1340|e3153a3c.name: Mountaineer Kadrell
1340|e3153a3c.text: Hello, $N.  Welcome to Thelsamar, and while you're here don't forget to visit our local brewery!

2057|f6158e52.name: Huldar
2057|f6158e52.text:
Delivering these barrels to the excavation site is hard work, but there are so many depending on us to get the blast powder there.

We must do what we can against the Dark Irons!

255-complete.name: Magistrate Bluntnose
255-complete.text: Ah, this is excellent news! Your efforts are greatly appreciated by myself and the people of Thelsamar. Better yet, if we can solve the ogre problem, we'll be able to shift our focus to those Light-burning troggs.
255-complete.title: Mercenaries

256-complete.name: Magistrate Bluntnose
256-complete.text:
Yech! What is that thing? And why would you bring it...

Bloody--! Is it? Well, Light burn me, is that the head of that bloody ogre? This certainly is a catch then! Here, your reward and the thanks of myself and the people of Thelsamar.
256-complete.title: WANTED: Chok'sul

256-progress.name: Magistrate Bluntnose
256-progress.text: Yes? Is there something I can do for you?
256-progress.title: WANTED: Chok'sul

271-complete.name: Daryl the Youngling
271-complete.text:
Er... what's this? A bear's head, by the looks at it.

<He runs a finger along his scar unconsciously.>

Well, that's quite an interesting kill you have yourself there. Couldn't be that bear from back then...

<He trails off then starts to visibly shake.>

Oh, take that away take it away! Get that grisly thing out of here!
271-complete.title: Vyrin's Revenge

271-progress.name: Daryl the Youngling
271-progress.text:
Ah, $N! Back so soon? No doubt you've been at the hunt again? Don't worry if you've had some setbacks, in the long run it will make you better!

...You couldn't get much worse, anyway...
271-progress.title: Vyrin's Revenge

273-complete.name: Huldar
273-complete.text:
Hmph, it'll take more than a Dark Iron ambush to stop the deliveries!

But Saean... I would never have suspected him to be one of their sympathizers. We've been working with him for almost a year now... maybe I missed the signs.

Well, I'll consider that later.
273-complete.title: Resupplying the Excavation

297-complete.name: Magmar Fellhew
297-complete.text:
You got them!  Nicely done, $N!

And you don't look too worse for wear, even with those berserk Troggs about.  I'm going to keep my eye on you...you show some promise.
297-complete.title: Gathering Idols

297-progress.name: Magmar Fellhew
297-progress.text: Do you have those Idols?  We must study them and report our findings to Ironforge!
297-progress.title: Gathering Idols

309-accept.name: Miran
309-accept.text:
Ready to go, $N?

First, we need to get this powder to Ironband. It'll be a lot for me to carry, and these parts can get dangerous -- and who knows what else the Dark Irons might have in store for me.

I'll feel a lot better with you coming along.
309-accept.title: Protecting the Shipment

309-complete.name: Prospector Ironband
309-complete.text:
Oh, thank the Light the powder is here. But it is troubling news that you bring as well. To think that the Dark Irons have sympathizers able to procure this sort of material for their dastardly plans.

That's a matter for someone else to consider, some other time. I must put this powder to good use.
309-complete.title: Protecting the Shipment

454-accept.name: Huldar
454-accept.text:
We'd been hauling the barrels of powder back and forth in trips before this... business. Now we have to split up the work, Miran's taking the barrels and I'm watching over the other ones.

I don't feel safe letting Miran haul the rest of the shipment by himself. When he's ready to go, maybe you could escort him on his next trip?
454-accept.title: After the Ambush

454-complete.name: Miran
454-complete.text:
Hello, $c.

You'll be escorting me to the excavation site? That's good to hear... After Saean and his cronies, who knows what else the Dark Irons might have up their sleeves?

Anyways, let me just make some final checks. Talk to me again when you're ready to go.
454-complete.title: After the Ambush

468-accept.name: Mountaineer Kadrell
468-accept.text:
Mountaineer Rockgar is looking for volunteers for a mission through Dun Algaz and into the Wetlands.  

If you want to get your boots wet in that soggy county to the north, then speak with Rockgar at Dun Algaz.  Dun Algaz is north up the road, beyond the guard tower.
468-accept.title: Report to Mountaineer Rockgar

531-accept.name: Daryl the Youngling
531-accept.text:
Light! Don't bring things like that into the Lodge... it's unsanitary, unspeakable, un... un... unsanitary!

Just get it out of here, will you? No one wants to see your bloody little trophy, really!
531-accept.title: Vyrin's Revenge

531-complete.name: Vyrin Swiftwind
531-complete.text: Thanks for helping me out with my little plan, $N. I've been itching for months to get back at that snooty, stuck-up boy, and I'd say we did a pretty good job! Here, have this, you've earned it.
531-complete.title: Vyrin's Revenge

531-progress.name: Vyrin Swiftwind
531-progress.text: Great job, $N! We really showed him! Here, give me the head and I'll take care of it.
531-progress.title: Vyrin's Revenge
